author: Audubon, 1839
status: 길잃은새, 2022년 10월 이후 처음 기록되어 2024년 목록에 오름
summary: 2022년 10월 이후 우리나라에서 처음 기록되어 2024년 목록에 오른 길잃은새이다. 북태평양 먼바다를 넓게 떠돌며 대륙붕이나 용승 해역에 많고, 배를 따라다니며 버려진 먹이를 줍기도 한다. 헤엄치면서 수면의 날치 알, 물고기, 오징어 등을 잡아먹는다. 대부분 하와이 제도 북서부에서 번식하고, 일본 도리시마와 오가사와라 제도 등에서도 적은 수가 번식한다.

white uppertail and undertail coverts in some birds

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 같고 수컷이 조금 크다.

young: 어린새는 온몸이 고르게 갈색이고 부리가 연한 갈색을 띠기도 한다. 나이를 먹을수록 부리 둘레의 흰 무늬가 넓어지고 꼬리덮깃에도 흰색이 생긴다.

art.subject: Black-footed Albatross (Phoebastria nigripes), adult: plumage almost entirely dark sooty brown; a white band encircling the base of the bill and a white crescent below and behind the eye; older birds show white on the uppertail coverts and undertail coverts; underwing dark brown. Bill dark grey-brown to blackish; legs and feet black.
art.pose: gliding low over the waves on stiff wings, side view
art.scene: open sea far off the Korean coast with long ocean swell; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view sitting on the sea: large, heavy-bodied albatross with almost entirely dark sooty-brown plumage, white feathering around the base of the bill, white patch below the eye, heavy dark grey bill

adult in flight seen squarely from below: head, body and tail in one line, very long narrow wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, dark sooty-brown body and wings, white around the bill base, white undertail coverts in some birds, short dark tail, black feet held under the tail

adult in flight seen squarely from above: head, body and tail in one line, very long narrow dark brown wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, dark sooty-brown back, white uppertail coverts in some birds, white around the bill base
art.build: Large albatross with a wingspan far greater than any gull's, similar in size to Laysan Albatross; heavy-bodied with a thick neck and large head. Bill stout, about as long as the head, deep and hooked at the tip. Legs short with large black webbed feet. Wings very long and narrow, held straight and stiff in gliding flight low over the sea with few wingbeats. Tail short, rounded and dark.
avoid: Do not give it a big pink bill — the dark juvenile Short-tailed Albatross (Phoebastria albatrus) has one; the Black-footed Albatross has a dark bill and a white ring around its base.
Do not paint a white head, body or underwing; it is sooty brown except the white face marks and pale tail coverts.
Do not paint pink or yellow feet; they are black.
Do not paint it like a dark gull or shearwater; it has the huge straight wings and heavy bill of an albatross.
